Neurotoxin injections are a popular and effective solution for reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, resulting in a smoother, more youthful complexion. These treatments work by temporarily relaxing the muscles responsible for causing dynamic wrinkles, such as crow’s feet, frown lines, and forehead creases. At AestheticEye in Cincinnati, we offer a range of neurotoxins to meet your aesthetic needs.

What Are Neurotoxins?

Neurotoxins are injectable treatments derived from botulinum toxin, which blocks nerve signals to the muscles, preventing them from contracting. This relaxation of the muscles leads to a reduction in the appearance of wrinkles and lines, providing a refreshed and rejuvenated look. Neurotoxin treatments are minimally invasive, involve little to no downtime, and deliver noticeable results within days.

Types of Neurotoxins We Offer at AestheticEye

Our Cincinnati clinic offers a selection of neurotoxins to suit different preferences and needs:

BOTOX®

The most well-known neurotoxin, BOTOX® is FDA-approved for treating various facial wrinkles and is widely used for both cosmetic and medical purposes.

Dysport

Another effective option, Dysport is known for its quick onset and natural-looking results. It spreads easily, making it ideal for treating larger areas.

Xeomin

A purified form of botulinum toxin, Xeomin is free from unnecessary proteins, which may reduce the risk of developing resistance to the treatment over time.

Benefits of Neurotoxin Injections

Neurotoxin injections offer numerous benefits, including:

Reduction of Wrinkles

Neurotoxins effectively smooth out dynamic wrinkles, providing a more youthful appearance.

Non-Surgical Treatment

This minimally invasive procedure requires no surgery or significant downtime.

Quick Results

Most patients notice improvements within a few days, with full results visible within two weeks.

Long-Lasting Effects

The results of neurotoxin injections typically last three to six months, with regular treatments maintaining a consistently youthful look.

The Neurotoxin Injection Procedure

The neurotoxin injection procedure is quick and straightforward. During your appointment, our skilled practitioner will assess your facial anatomy and aesthetic goals to determine the appropriate injection sites and dosage. The treatment involves using a fine needle to inject the neurotoxin into the targeted muscles, with minimal discomfort.

Post-treatment, you may experience slight redness, swelling, or bruising at the injection sites, but these side effects are temporary and usually resolve within a few days. You can resume your normal activities immediately after the procedure, making it a convenient option for those with busy lifestyles.
